Nice place to have a drink overseeing the nice lake!
Mar 2019 • Family
This building is one of the most iconic landmarks in the city center of Hanoi and it is located at a corner of 4 roads and thus have a massive motor traffic at any time of the day, that is directly opposite Hoan Kiem Lake and also a short walk from St Joseph Cathedral. You won't miss it for sure!

The building housed a number of cafes and restaurants and throughout our stay in Hanoi, we passed by it almost every day, day and night, but the night view is much pretty due to the lightings.

We went for coffee at Highlands Cafe, our regular and one of our favourite cafes in Vietnam. From here, we could have a good view overseeing the lake. That's lovely. Service was efficient and as usually good ice coffee.

And on weekends, the roads around the area were closed at the round-about for motor and vehicular traffic and many people roamed the roads freely and there were groups of performers, dancers and singers doing live performances. It was very crowded and many people would gather to enjoy the performances and uplifted the celebratory spirit and mood!
